title: Titan Company Limited (NSE: TITAN) — Institutional Investment Dossier
holding_rationale: TITAN is not held in our Zerodha account (₹42,64,304.99 net worth; ₹14,20,949.94 cash on the Nov 23 ledger). Business quality stays Compounder Pass (Pass with Watch). Yet stripping ₹1,614 Cr of H1 FY27 one-offs lifts true normalized TTM P/E to 73.4x at ₹4,680.00 (73.5x live TV). Q2 normalized PBT slowed to +17.8% YoY while financial debt doubled to ₹24,191 Cr. Grounded FY28E EPS (₹81.00) caps Base Fair Value at ₹4,950.00, leaving +3.10% EV and 1.02:1 support asymmetry. We assign Rejected on Valuation (Tier-0) and retain 100% cash.

holding_alerts.instruction: Do not deploy capital into the ₹4,550.00–₹4,662.64 ledger shelf or ₹4,609.49–₹4,749.89 live TradingView band; 1.02:1 asymmetry to ₹4,950.00 fails our 1.50:1 hurdle.
Monitor ₹4,380.00 (beneath the rising 200-DMA at ₹4,495.67 ledger / ₹4,504.41 live TV); a weekly close below confirms Stage 4 markdown.
Re-open full valuation underwriting only if TITAN resets toward ₹4,150–₹4,250 (~51x–52.5x FY28E normalized EPS) and builds a fresh Stage 2 base.
Base Fair Value ceiling (61.1x FY28E normalized EPS of ₹81.00); rallies above ₹4,950.00 without buyer-growth acceleration further compress forward returns.

destinations.entry_condition: Deploy selectively only into underwritten Stage 2 setups offering >=1.50:1 support asymmetry and >11.0% expected return.

primer: Titan remains an elite Tata Group franchise with zero share dilution since FY15, 20.5% ROCE, and an AAA credit rating. Still, our refresh cuts new capital to Rejected on Valuation (Tier-0) at ₹4,680.00 (₹4,686.60 live TradingView). Stripping ₹1,614 crore of H1 FY27 one-offs cuts normalized TTM profit to ₹5,660 crore (₹63.75 EPS), lifting true P/E from 59.1x to 73.4x. Grounded FY28E EPS of ₹81.00 caps Base Fair Value at ₹4,950.00, leaving +3.10% Expected Value and 1.02:1 support asymmetry. Titan is not held, so we commit 0% capital and keep 100% of our ₹14,20,949.94 Zerodha cash intact.

technical_spec.intro_prose: The chart below tracks live NSE:TITAN trading, while the table reconciles two dated feeds explicitly. Daily close (₹4,680.00), daily SMAs (50-DMA ₹4,662.64, +0.37% above), and Stage 3 come from the November 23, 2026 NSE ledger. Weekly averages (10W EMA ₹4,679.69; 30W SMA ₹4,614.57) and snapshot extensions (+0.15% vs 10W EMA; +0.66% vs 50-DMA ₹4,655.66 at ₹4,686.60) come from the live November 25, 2026 TradingView snapshot.
technical_spec.stage_explanation: Authoritative Nov 23 NSE ledger flags Stage 3 (Topping / Pullback) with a falling 50-DMA (₹4,662.64), 6 distribution days, and -12.27% 63D RS. Live Nov 25 TradingView (₹4,686.60) screens as Stage 2 (+0.15% vs 10W EMA ₹4,679.69). The stricter ledger Stage 3 warning and 73.4x normalized P/E govern our Valuation Rejection.
technical_spec.tech_table_takeaway: Feed reconciliation: Nov 23 NSE ledger close ₹4,680.00 sits +0.37% above its falling 50-DMA (₹4,662.64) in Stage 3; live Nov 25 TradingView close ₹4,686.60 sits +0.66% above its 50-DMA (₹4,655.66) and +0.15% above its 10W EMA (₹4,679.69) in Stage 2. Both feeds fail our 1.50:1 valuation gate.
technical_spec.gate_intro_prose: This screen compares our November 23 NSE ledger Stage 3 trend against the November 25 live TradingView timing screen. Our Valuation Rejection (73.4x normalized P/E; 1.02:1 R:R) overrides mechanical screen labels.
technical_spec.evaluation_stage_explanation: Nov 23 NSE ledger flags Stage 3 (falling 50-DMA, 6 distribution days, -12.27% 63D RS); live Nov 25 TradingView screens as Stage 2 (+0.15% vs 10W EMA). Both feeds yield 1.02:1 R:R to ₹4,950.00.
technical_spec.posture_explanation: Live Nov 25 TradingView screen flags non-extended support (+0.15% vs 10W EMA at ₹4,686.60), yet 1.02:1 asymmetry and 73.4x normalized P/E forbid deployment.
technical_spec.support_zone_explanation: Live Nov 25 TradingView support band (₹4,609.49–₹4,749.89; Nov 23 ledger shelf ₹4,550.00–₹4,662.64). Both offer just 1.02:1 R:R to ₹4,950.00—monitor only.
technical_spec.stop_placement_explanation: Live Nov 25 TradingView mechanical stop (₹4,554.24; 1.09 ATRs below price). Our structural 200-DMA floor sits at ₹4,380.00 (monitor-only reference; no live position).

valuation_assessment.posture: Stretched on Normalized Earnings (73.4x ex-H1 one-offs)
valuation_assessment.note: Overrides the generic 'Reasonable / In-line' TradingView screen label (59.14x headline P/E); stripping ₹1,614 Cr H1 one-offs lifts true P/E to 73.4x at ₹4,680.00 (73.5x live TV).

technical_spec.gate_table_takeaway: Even where live Nov 25 TradingView screens as Stage 2 support, the Nov 23 ledger Stage 3 warning, 73.4x normalized P/E, and 1.02:1 R:R enforce our Valuation Rejection.
technical_spec.closing_prose: Reconciling both feeds confirms why technical support never overrides valuation discipline. We commit zero capital and track ₹4,250.00 as a deep-value reset trigger.

sizing_table_takeaway: Zero new capital is allocated under our Valuation Rejection (Tier-0). All listed levels are monitor-only markers until price resets below ₹4,250.00 or core buyer growth and GML funding recover.
